notes.title: Handy is now available in early access!
notes.notes:
Handy is now available in early access!
Which means that time has come to refine and polish the game while adding additional content. And you can help me do it by rating the game, describing your experience, telling me what you would like to see in the future updates and most importantly - reporting bugs.
You can reach me by posting to the Discussion page or by writing an email to 
makeabetterhand@gmail.com
